seo.title: Devendra Kumar - Full-Stack Engineer
seo.description: I help product teams design and deliver performant web applications using React, Angular, Node.js, and cloud-native delivery practices.

hero.name: Devendra Kumar
summary: I help teams ship scalable, maintainable web products in finance, fitness, and event-management domains.
My focus is high-performance UI engineering, reliable backend integrations, and fast delivery cycles.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I started web development in 2016 and have since built production systems across regulated and high-volume environments.
I work end-to-end from interface architecture to API integration, and I lead teams to ship predictable releases with strong code quality.

milestones.info: Started with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Linux, Java, Servlet, and JSP.
Joined GSS Pvt. Ltd.; built enterprise modules with Java, Spring, Angular, and Node.js.
Joined OakNorth Global Pvt. Ltd.; delivered full-stack features with React, Node.js, APIs, and SQL.
Joined HDOR Events Pvt. Ltd. and progressed into team leadership on multi-platform products.

highlights: Led delivery of event platform modules with frontend and backend ownership.
Mentored developers and improved release confidence through better engineering practices.
Built production workflows in fintech systems with strong reliability requirements.
Delivered scalable UI and API integrations for core banking-related processes.
Developed modules using Java ecosystem and modern frontend frameworks.
Gained cross-functional experience in enterprise application delivery.
